name: Kingdoms Assemble
description:
About This Game

About This Game

In Kingdoms Assemble, auto-battler combat, roster building, and kingdom management come together. You never need to micromanage units in real time—your only job is to decide how the kingdom grows: which plots of land to buy, which territories to expand into, and which kingdom to attack next.

When battle begins, the two kingdoms merge into a single battlefield. Barracks recruit units, heroes lead the army, and wonders grant unique bonuses. Every choice you make is put to the test in automatic combat.

Place, Reclaim, Combine

Every kingdom starts from a limited area. Arrange your capital, barracks, and supporting tiles within this tight space so they work together to form a steadily operating war machine.

Reclaim tiles to open up more building space, and combine certain low-tier tiles into higher-tier ones. Refine your layout and push your kingdom toward a stronger form.

Auto Battles: Your Layout Decides the Outcome

In combat, units advance on their own, seek out targets, and attack enemy units and buildings. Your tiles produce resources, recruit units, grant buffs, or call down devastating lightning strikes.

You cannot micromanage mid-battle, so the real tactics happen before the fighting begins. Either way, your ultimate goal is to destroy the enemy capital.

Events, Wonders, and Choices

Mysterious offerings, visitors from afar, wonder merchants, or hero breakthroughs... every turn, events unfold both inside and outside your kingdom.

Events open up new opportunities, but their costs vary. There is no single correct answer between short-term gain and long-term risk—only the choice that fits the current situation.

Multiple Factions and Battle Mechanics

With races like Goblins, Beasts, Machines, and Dragons, plus signature mechanics such as Assembly, Promotion, Awakening, and Swarm, you can build completely different combat styles.

Steady advancement, beast horde tactics, machine assembly, or the descent of a dragon... master one strategy or combine them to discover your own path to victory.

Challenge Other Players' Kingdoms

The map is dotted with kingdoms that are far from stationary targets—they are historical rosters of other players, revealing different strengths at different turns.

Victory expands your territory; defeat costs you prestige. Conquer enough kingdoms before your prestige runs dry to win the entire game.

Key Features

  • Fantasy strategy auto-battler: manage your kingdom, build your army, and let the battles unfold automatically.

  • Tile-based layout strategy: buy, place, combine, and reclaim tiles to forge a war machine within a limited board.

  • Asynchronous PvP battles: face off against other players' historical rosters—no real-time matchmaking needed.

  • Multiple build paths: factions, heroes, races, signature mechanics, and wonders shape your unique lineup.

  • Rich event choices: weigh costs between resources, prestige, and long-term gains.

  • World map conquest: pick adjacent targets, annex territory, endure defeat, and keep pushing after victory.
short_desc: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!
